scope_guards: Domestic and non-domestic private-rented MEES regimes remain distinct.
An EPC rating is a certificate assessment and not proof of current occupancy, tenancy or ownership.
The current minimum and any future proposed trajectory must not be silently merged.
An exemption-register entry must be matched to the exact property, reason and validity dates.
Absence from the exemption register is not proof of compliance, occupation or enforceability without scope checks.
EPC expiry, replacement and multiple certificates require chronology review.
MEES compliance is not planning permission, building-condition survey, retrofit cost or redevelopment viability.
No score or promotion is written without exact EPC, tenancy scope, exemption, enforcement and property evidence.
